scenario: H0 draft human-only US-101 northbound baseline
assumptions: Simulation time 00:15 corresponds to observed time 07:00 after a 15-minute warmup.
PeMS total five-minute station flow is converted to vehicles per hour by multiplying by 12.
This first runnable baseline uses mainline passenger-car demand only; ramp demand and vehicle mix are not calibrated yet.
Observed PeMS speed is a validation target, not a commanded vehicle speed.
The mainline route passes through ordered detector-matched checkpoints so shortest-path routing cannot leave US-101 for a ramp shortcut.
Human behavior uses SUMO's stochastic Krauss following model and default lane-changing model.
